patterns: APPSC asks single-fact source/name items: Jhelum rises at Verinag, Tsangpo = Brahmaputra, Kishanganga -> Jhelum, river through Srinagar, rivers not from Mansarovar (Beas).
Superlatives recur: westernmost and longest Ganga tributary (Yamuna), largest riverine island (Majuli), Himalayan rivers perennial/ox-bow lakes (A-R).
Other PSCs heavily ask dam/project -> river (Tehri, Baglihar, Pong, Maithon, Gandhi Sagar) and confluence (Devprayag) items, repeated many times.
Trap shapes: left vs right bank tributaries (Son right; Subansiri/Manas right of Brahmaputra), sequence of confluences west-to-east, Sutlej originates outside India.
App adds 2026 current-affairs items (Son MoU, IIT study, GRCA) and multi-statement items; core facts align with PYQs.
